title: onprem/airgap: vendor RKE2 + Flatcar into offline bundle, update helm charts and packaging
author: Asha Patel
description: Add RKE2 and Flatcar images/binaries to the on-prem offline bundle, vendor TUF metadata and updated Helm chart manifests required for Flatcar + RKE2 clusters, and improve packaging scripts for deterministic bundle builds. Motivation: customers using RKE2 and Flatcar in air-gapped environments reported missing distro artifacts and failing installer validation during upgrades. This PR: 1) vendors RKE2 binaries and Flatcar OS artifacts into the offline bundle with checksums and TUF metadata, 2) updates helm chart values and templates to support containerd socket path differences and systemd unit tweaks on Flatcar, 3) extends package-offline-bundle.sh to produce deterministic tarballs and include a 'manifest.json' of vendored artifacts, 4) adds an integration test that deploys the installer in a local RKE2 + Flatcar VM to smoke test the airgap flow, 5) documents upgrade steps and rollback notes for RKE2 clusters in docs/upgrade-rke2-flatcar.md. Checklist: - [x] Vendor RKE2 binaries and signatures - [x] Add Flatcar artifacts and verify checksums - [x] Update Helm chart defaults and templates - [x] Add integration test job (airgap-smoke) - [x] Update packaging script for reproducible output - [x] Add docs and release notes. Backwards compatibility: installers for k3s/rke2 non-Flatcar unchanged; chart changes guarded by distro detection logic. Related: ENG-3491 (customer pilot), SUP-1123 (support case).
